newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Australia's Ampol to shut CDU at Lytton refinery.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Ampol to shut CDU at Lytton refinery.

text.p: Australian Petroleum Pty Ltd (Ampol) plans a maintenance shutdown of a 40,000 barrels per day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) at its Lytton refinery in Brisbane for three weeks from mid August, a refinery source said on Wednesday.
A separate 55,000 bpd CDU at the 95,000-bpd refinery will remain in operation, the source said.
The maintenance shutdown had been scheduled for the third quarter since early this year, but an exact date has just been fixed, the source said.
Ampol's 115,000-bpd Kurnell refinery in Sydney had a maintenance shutdown of its fluid catalytic cracker in February, and there is no other maintenance planned for this year.
Ampol is equally owned by Caltex Australia Ltd and Pioneer International.
